high_level_description: This image depicts a framed painting of the Virgin Mary holding the infant Jesus. The painting is set within an ornate, gold-colored frame that features intricate carvings and a triangular pediment at the top. The frame itself is quite elaborate, suggesting a piece of significant artistic or historical value. The Virgin Mary is seated, wearing a white headscarf and a red robe over a black undergarment. Her expression is serene and contemplative as she gazes downward toward the infant Jesus. The infant Jesus is positioned on her lap, appearing to be asleep or resting peacefully.
